records.prompt: Which object is longer? A 12 cm pencil or an 8 cm crayon?
records.feedbackIncorrect: Good try. Think carefully and try once more.

optionRationales.a: Correct: this choice matches the measurement comparison in the question.
optionRationales.b: Compare the two measurements and check which quantity is greater.
optionRationales.c: Compare the two measurements and check which quantity is greater.

records.prompt: A ribbon is 5 blocks long. A string is 3 blocks long. How many blocks longer is the ribbon?
records.feedbackCorrect: Well done! Five blocks is two more than three blocks.
records.feedbackIncorrect: Count on from 3 to 5 to find the difference.

optionRationales.a: One block is not the difference between five and three.
optionRationales.b: Five is two more than three.
optionRationales.c: Three is the length of the shorter object, not the difference.

records.prompt: Jug A holds 4 cups. Jug B holds 6 cups. Which jug holds more?
records.feedbackCorrect: Correct! Six cups is more than four cups.
records.feedbackIncorrect: Compare the number of cups each jug holds.

optionRationales.a: Four cups is fewer than six cups.
optionRationales.b: Six cups is more than four cups.
optionRationales.c: The two amounts are not equal.

records.prompt: A pencil is 8 cubes long. A crayon is 5 cubes long. A ruler is 10 cubes long. Which is the shortest?
records.feedbackCorrect: Correct! Five cubes is the smallest length.
records.feedbackIncorrect: Compare 8 cubes, 5 cubes and 10 cubes. Choose the smallest length.

optionRationales.a: Eight cubes is longer than five cubes.
optionRationales.b: Five cubes is the shortest measurement.
optionRationales.c: Ten cubes is the longest measurement.
